summary: Issue #1 adds a new public function, sub(a, b), and no accepted decision record covers it, so this run writes only the proposed decision record 0001 (new file src/sub.js, as UC-1 names it), adds it to the index and to UC-1's ADRs column, and asks orus to open it as an adr pull request. actions.title: ADR 0001: subtraction is a new exported function sub(a, b) in src/sub.js
actions.body:
Proposes decision record 0001 for UC-1 (subtract two numbers, For #1).

Why a record is needed: `sub` is a new public interface, and no accepted decision covers it. The record sets the question (one module per operation, or `sub` added to `src/add.js`), the two options with their costs, and the chosen option: a new file `src/sub.js`, as UC-1 names it. Status is Proposed, and the owner decides.

Changes: the new record `docs/adr/0001-subtract-in-its-own-module.md`, its row in the decision index, and `0001` in UC-1's ADRs column. No test or code is in this pull request. After the owner merges it, a new dev run writes the test and the code.

The record follows UC-1.
